g.title: crate Dense creative-tool controls, panels and editor surfaces.
crate::audio Transport, meter and mixer strip controls of the Creative kit.
crate::audio::meter The level Meter: segmented, oriented, multi-channel level bars.

crate::audio::transport The transport bar: its TransportState and play, stop and position view.
crate::audio::view_state Application-owned bindings for this component view state.

crate::bezier::view::implementation The BezierCurve builder and its plot, handles and coordinate fields.
crate::choice The Creative segmented look of the standard radio group.
crate::color The creative kit's own colors as values a style or a draw call accepts.
crate::color_popup::implementation Color popup of the Creative kit with live editing and rollback.
crate::color_wheel Color wheel, model fields and palette using one edit transaction.

crate::color_wheel::fields::data Shared control values and edit snapshots.
crate::color_wheel::fields::implementation Model fields, hexadecimal drafts and optional editable swatches.

crate::color_wheel::state::data Shared control values and edit snapshots.
crate::color_wheel::state::implementation Color picker values and shared edit transaction.
crate::color_wheel::view The ColorWheel builder and its wheel, sliders, fields and swatches.
crate::control_style Creative field, check and segment style helpers.
crate::controls The toolbar button look shared by the kit's recipes.
crate::curve_preview A read-only finite sampled easing curve with time and progress axes.
crate::dock A docking workspace: splits of tabbed containers with retained panels.
crate::dock::chrome Container chrome of a dock: the tab strip, inline rename and the container menu.

crate::dock::operations Dock text resolution and shared layout editing operations.
crate::dock::view The Dock builder and the chrome, content and dividers it lays out.
crate::dock_style Passive dock splitter dimensions and theme appearance.
crate::dope_sheet A dedicated dope sheet builder over logical-time models.

crate::editors::arrangement::view The Arrangement builder and the track canvas view it builds.
crate::editors::arrangement::view_state Application-owned bindings for this component view state.
